podcast.body: Cited as Ariel Pink's most popular song, "Round and Round" from 2010 serves as a prime example of music made possible by cheap home recording equipment, embodying the low-fi and Bedroom Pop aesthetics. Ariel Rosenberg, the project's founder, built his fanbase by producing such home-recorded albums. "This is probably his most popular song. He's from 2010 and is called Round and Round."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 5: (60-51)
